EPISODE_NARRATIVE: A strong storm system moving through the Lower Mississippi River Valley developed a well defined squall line that moved across southeast Louisiana and adjacent coastal waters during the afternoon hours of the 13th. Numerous reports of wind damage occurred across the area.
EVENT_NARRATIVE: Two lightning strikes caused a power outage that disabled the drawbridge on the Lake Pontchartrain Causeway.

CZ_NAME: ENGLEWOOD TO TARPON SPRINGS FL OUT 20NM
EPISODE_NARRATIVE: Evening thunderstorms cause a fatality when lightning strikes a woman outdoors.
EVENT_NARRATIVE: Body of a 73-year-old woman was discovered on Sand Key in Clearwater after being struck by lightning.
